content: Amoxicillin is supplied in various forms and dosages, as described below: Amoxicillin Capsules, USP Each capsule contains either 250 mg or 500 mg of amoxicillin in the form of amoxicillin trihydrate. 250 mg Capsule: These capsules are yellow, opaque, and have a size 2 configuration. They are imprinted with RX654 on both the cap and body. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-654-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-654-30: Bottles of 30 NDC 63304-654-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-654-05: Bottles of 500 NDC 63304-654-77: Unit-dose packs of 100 500 mg Capsule: These capsules have a maroon opaque cap and a yellow opaque body, with a size 0-el configuration. They are imprinted with RX655 on both the cap and body. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-762-82: Bottles of 12 NDC 63304-762-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-762-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-762-13: Bottles of 120 NDC 63304-762-05: Bottles of 500 Amoxicillin Tablets, USP Each tablet contains either 500 mg or 875 mg of amoxicillin in the form of amoxicillin trihydrate. 500 mg Tablet: These tablets are pink, film-coated, and capsule-shaped. They are debossed with RX762 on one side and plain on the other. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-762-82: Bottles of 12 NDC 63304-762-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-762-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-762-13: Bottles of 120 NDC 63304-762-05: Bottles of 500 875 mg Tablet: These tablets are pink, film-coated, and capsule-shaped. They are debossed with RX763 on one side and scored on the reverse side. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-763-82: Bottles of 12 NDC 63304-763-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-763-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-763-13: Bottles of 120 NDC 63304-763-05: Bottles of 500 Amoxicillin Chewable Tablets, USP Each chewable tablet contains 125 mg, 200 mg, 250 mg, or 400 mg of amoxicillin in the form of amoxicillin trihydrate. 125 mg Tablet: These tablets are pink, strawberry-flavored, oval, and biconvex with a mottled appearance. They are debossed with RX514 on one side. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-514-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-514-05: Bottles of 500 200 mg Tablet: These tablets are light pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, and beveled-edged with a mottled appearance. They are debossed with RX760 on one side. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-760-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-760-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-760-05: Bottles of 500 250 mg Tablet: These tablets are pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, and beveled-edged with a mottled appearance. They are debossed with RX515 on one side. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-515-30: Bottles of 30 NDC 63304-515-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-515-04: Bottles of 250 400 mg Tablet: These tablets are light pink, strawberry-flavored, circular, flat-faced, and beveled-edged with a mottled appearance. They are debossed with RX716 on one side. Packaging options include: NDC 63304-761-20: Bottles of 20 NDC 63304-761-01: Bottles of 100 NDC 63304-761-05: Bottles of 500 Amoxicillin for Oral Suspension, USP This formulation is available as a granular powder that forms a suspension upon reconstitution with water. It is available in two strengths: 200 mg per 5 mL and 400 mg per 5 mL. The powder is off-white to light orange and forms a light orange to orange suspension with a characteristic fruity flavor. 200 mg/5 mL Oral Suspension: Packaging options include: NDC 63304-969-03: 50 mL bottles NDC 63304-969-01: 75 mL bottles NDC 63304-969-04: 100 mL bottles 400 mg/5 mL Oral Suspension: Packaging options include: NDC 63304-970-03: 50 mL bottles NDC 63304-970-01: 75 mL bottles NDC 63304-970-04: 100 mL bottles Instructions for Use: Shake the oral suspension well before use. Keep the bottle tightly closed. Any unused portion of the reconstituted suspension must be discarded after 14 days. Refrigeration is preferable but not required. Dispense in a tight container. Storage Instructions Store amoxicillin capsules (250 mg and 500 mg), tablets (500 mg and 875 mg), chewable tablets (125 mg, 200 mg, 250 mg, and 400 mg), and unreconstituted powder for oral suspension (200 mg/5 mL and 400 mg/5 mL) at controlled room temperature, between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F), as per USP guidelines.
